value.title: Write a workstream
value.summary: Write a workstream: put PRD rows and blueprint components in an order of steps, each naming the plan and roles that do it.

value.who: The PM that owns the work, or the prime when the operator asks.
value.when: When a project needs a new workstream. Run it with `--key <slug>` so each document keeps its own progress.

value.name: slug
value.description: the kebab-case slug the PRD, blueprint and workstream share

value.title: Claim the workstream number
value.done_when: `pij claim workstream` holds a number for the slug, or `docs/project/workstreams/NNN-<slug>.dd.json` already exists.

value.title: Write the workstream
value.done_when: The workstream's sections are filled as `writing.md` says, every placeholder replaced.

value.title: Validate and render it
value.done_when: `ddocs validate` reports 0 errors and 0 warnings and the `.dd.md` is rebuilt and staged.

sections.name: done_when
sections.value: `docs/project/workstreams/NNN-<slug>.dd.json` validates clean, its rendering is current, and both are staged.

value.text: Run ddocs from the repo root; the recipes do. From a subdirectory ddocs can't find the pij/* schemas (E401).
Guessing the number from the folder listing instead of claiming it.

value.guarantees: The workstream how-to is this procedure; the old page points here.

value.text: Live run owed (PRD 005 req-24): the next seat to write a new document of this type runs it, recording each step with pij proc. The PR that made the procedures current wrote none.
